name: upload_file
description: Upload one file, provided as base64 content in requestBody, so a later create_deployment call can reference it by SHA1 and size. Use xVercelDigest (the file's SHA1) and contentLength to identify and verify the file.

requestBody.description: Provide this binary value as a base64 string.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

xNowDigest.description: The file SHA1 used to check the integrity

xNowSize.description: The file size as an alternative to `Content-Length`

xVercelDigest.description: The file SHA1 used to check the integrity
